thread:
incident-bot: ALARM — High error rate observed for dedicated pool 'galileo-dedicated-01' (VPC tenant galileo). Metric: 5xx/sec spike, sustained >3m. Paging oncall.

sara (oncall): Acknowledged. Jumping in. Can someone post recent deploys? :eyes:

jonah-eng: No deploys in last 2h from core infra. I'm seeing increased latency on the pool side (p95 token latency up ~4x). Logs show token cache misses and timeouts to the model-serving pods.

kevin-sre: I’m on it. Querying pool health now. Quick check: `rdwctl pools describe galileo-dedicated-01 --region us-west2` -> returning partial for the pool leader.

sara (oncall): Paste the recent pod states

kevin-sre: ```
# kubectl -n inference get pods -l pool=galileo-dedicated-01
galileo-infer-0   CrashLoopBackOff   3/5   1h
galileo-infer-1   Running            1/1   3h
galileo-cache-0   Running            1/1   4h
galileo-proxy-0   Running            1/1   2d
```  
CrashLoopBackOff on infer-0 correlates to the error spikes.

sara (oncall): Any OOMs or GPU driver alerts?

jonah-eng: No OOMs on node, but I see repeated kernel warnings: `NVML: GPU reset detected` around the time of CrashLoopBackOff. Node `g-west-12` shows high GPU temperature, but thermal throttling didn't trigger earlier alerts.

kevin-sre: Taking node out of rotation, draining. `kubectl drain g-west-12 --ignore-daemonsets --delete-local-data` in progress.

incident-bot: NOTE — automatic fallback routing enabled for affected tenant. Traffic is being routed to fallback variant `galileo-dedicated-01-fallback` while we mitigate.

sara (oncall): Good. Lina, can you confirm customer impact? Lina-cs: pinging.

lina-cs: Heard from Galileo support: some API calls returned 502s for ~12-18 minutes, retry logic recovered for most clients but they saw a visible UX bump. They're asking for timeline and whether data was exposed (they are VPC, so isolated tenant).

megan-am: I'll loop in the account team. We need a short customer comm ASAP and flag for credits per SLA if outage confirmed.

kevin-sre: Node drain completed. Restarting affected pod with clean env. `kubectl rollout restart deployment/galileo-infer` started.

jonah-eng: Restart successful, and p95 latency dropping back toward baseline. Observability shows request success rate improving after reroute. Monitoring will keep the fallback route for 10m to ensure stability.

sara (oncall): Root cause hypothesis so far: GPU hardware glitch caused model server to crash and cascade into cache/population thrashing, increasing latency and 5xxs. Hard to say if it's driver-level or HW — need node-level dmesg and NVML logs.

kevin-sre: Collected logs and uploaded to incident bucket: `s3://redwood-incidents/3642009876/`. Key files: `g-west-12-dmesg.log`, `nvml-events.log`, `infer-0-pod.log`.

sara (oncall): Good. For customer comm we must say: brief timeline, impact, mitigation (traffic reroute + node drain), next steps (root cause investigation, potential credit). Lina, draft a short note for Galileo ops. Keep it non-technical and include ETA for RCA.

lina-cs: Drafting now. Proposed short note: "We experienced a partial service disruption for your dedicated inference pool in us-west2 resulting in intermittent errors and higher latency between 14:12–14:30 UTC. We routed traffic to a fallback variant within 3 minutes and fully restored service by 14:33 UTC. No tenant data was exposed; your VPC remained isolated. We're investigating root cause and will share an RCA by EOD tomorrow. Our customer success rep will follow up about credits per SLA." Thoughts?

megan-am: That looks good — please add exact times in UTC and the mitigation steps. I'll review and send once RCA ETA confirmed.

kevin-sre: For internal ops notes: collecting NVML and kernel logs, performing hardware diagnostics on g-west-12. If hardware fault confirmed, we'll schedule hardware replacement and cordon node.

jonah-eng: Also re-running health tests for model-serving image to ensure no regression. Adding a canary deploy for galileo-dedicated-01-fallback to catch regressions.

sara (oncall): Action items:
- kevin-sre: Investigate node hardware/driver, update by +3h.
- jonah-eng: Run smoke tests + canary, confirm by +1h.
- lina-cs/megan-am: Send interim customer comm within 30m.
- sara (oncall): Draft RCA outline, own final post-incident comm and exec summary.

incident-bot: REMINDER — oncall handoff in 40m. If still hot, do not handoff until stabilization confirmed.

lina-cs: Sending customer note now. Copy of message posted to Galileo's support ticket (ticket #GAL-4521).

megan-am: I'll prepare SLA credit calc. Preliminary: outage window 18 minutes, customer has 99.9% monthly uptime SLA — credit might be pro-rated per SLA guidelines. Will share calc in #billing later.

sara (oncall): Thanks team. Keep updates here. If we confirm hardware cause, we should offer a proactive maintenance window to Galileo and propose a small credit as goodwill even if SLA boundary is ambiguous.

kevin-sre: Update: NVML logs show repeated GPU ECC errors leading up to crash. Tentative hardware fault. Marking as probable hardware. I'll escalate to hw-ops for replacement. More details in the uploaded logs.

jonah-eng: Canary looks healthy. No further error spikes after routing and node replacement started. p95 and error rates stable for 12m.

lina-cs: Galileo replied: appreciated quick mitigation; requesting RCA and confirmation on replacement and preventive steps. Asked if we can give an estimated timeline for hardware swap.

megan-am: I'll coordinate exec update. Proposed content: impact summary, mitigation timeline, hardware replacement plan, next steps, and provisional credit. Will route through legal if we phrase SLA commitments.

sara (oncall): Closing notes for thread: service restored, fallback route will be removed in 30m if stable, RCA draft due EOD tom, hw replacement scheduled within 48h, account team to propose credit and exec summary. If nothing new, I'll handoff to the next oncall at +40m.

kevin-sre: Filing post-incident ticket with labels: incident:galileo-vpc, probable_root:gpu-hardware, followup:hw-replace, owner:kevin-sre.

incident-bot: INCIDENT MARKER — status: mitigated, impact: partial outage for tenant Galileo, mitigation: fallback routing / node drain, next: RCA.

sara (oncall): Thanks all. I'll convert notes into RCA skeleton and ping for reviews. :white_check_mark:
